If your tracking number hasn't updated after a few days, carrier scans can sometimes be delayed while the package is in transit between facilities.
If there are no tracking updates after 5 business days from shipment, please contact our support team at +1 844 396 3737 or via our online contact form so we can investigate the package location for you.
